name: v15_acquisition_payment_discipline
hypothesis: Large acquisition cash outflows can proxy empire-building and integration risk. Prefer firms with lower acquisition payments, backed by operating profitability and a small intraday reversal stabilizer.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * business_acquisition_payments_net / assets, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / assets, 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * rank(-(close / open - 1))
notes: Different from low goodwill level: tests acquisition cash-payment discipline directly.

name: v15_acquired_goodwill_intensity
hypothesis: Goodwill newly acquired during deals may be a cleaner acquisition-risk signal than the total goodwill stock. Lower acquired-goodwill intensity should be preferable when operating cash flow is solid.
expression: 0.65 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * fnd6_acqgdwl / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(cashflow_op / assets, 126), subindustry) + 0.10 * rank(-(close / open - 1))
notes: Watch correlation with mL8j98w9, but acquired-goodwill flow should differ from goodwill/assets level.

name: v15_goodwill_growth_discipline
hypothesis: Rising goodwill can indicate acquisition accounting risk even when the level is not yet extreme. Penalize goodwill growth relative to assets and require operating quality.
expression: 0.60 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(goodwill, 252) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / assets, 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * rank(-(close / open - 1))
notes: Change-based sibling of low goodwill; only submit if correlation to mL8j98w9 stays safely below 0.68.

name: v15_acquisition_income_contribution
hypothesis: Acquisitions with positive income contribution may be higher quality than acquisition avoidance alone. This tests the positive contribution side of the M&A accounting family.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_aqi / assets, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(cashflow_op / assets, 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * rank(-(close / open - 1))
notes: Positive M&A-quality variant; included to avoid only testing negative acquisition exposure.

name: v15_deferred_tax_valuation_allowance_quality
hypothesis: Higher deferred-tax valuation allowance can indicate weaker future taxable income expectations or lower accounting quality. Penalize it and pair with profitability.
expression: 0.60 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * deferred_tax_assets_valuation_allowance_value / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / assets, 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * rank(-(close / open - 1))
notes: New tax-accounting mechanism; not a near-neighbor of receivables/deferred revenue/goodwill.

name: v15_unrecognized_tax_benefit_risk
hypothesis: Unrecognized tax benefits can proxy tax-position uncertainty. Prefer lower tax uncertainty when cashflow quality is strong.
expression: 0.60 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * fn_unrecognized_tax_benefits_a / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(cashflow_op / assets, 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * rank(-(close / open - 1))
notes: Tax-risk branch; strict sub-universe and correlation gate.

name: v15_mna_news_slow_discipline
hypothesis: M&A news impact is a different Ravenpack event type from earnings news. Combine slow M&A news with acquisition payment discipline and only a small profitability anchor.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_mna, 90), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * business_acquisition_payments_net / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / assets, 126), subindustry)
notes: No close/open component; intended to avoid the news+reversal correlation wall.

name: v15_product_news_margin
hypothesis: Product and service news may capture demand/product-cycle information not present in earnings news. Gross margin helps filter low-quality hype.
expression: 0.60 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_product, 90), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newa1v1300_gp / sales, 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * rank(-(close / open - 1))
notes: Non-earnings Ravenpack test; correlation should be checked against RRpmOAWj and reversal-heavy actives.
